scope: Prospective source-only crosswalk and raw human-feature preparation; not a complete model feature record
property_rationale: Retain all ten named nondeprecated object-property means, the corrected follow-up arousal mean, and perceived size mean. Preserve recorded units; no worker-level responses, response times or rating counts become predictors.
category_rule: All 53 provider broad-category membership columns, preserving multiple memberships. No 27-category scheme, reference-category dropping or concept-identity one-hot encoding.
category_rationale: One explicit current provider taxonomy supplies the required human-category feature family and a prospective broad-category identity crosswalk.
missing_source_value_rule: Retain as missing and report exact affected concept/field keys; do not impute or exclude concepts in this source preparation.
downstream_scaling_and_PCA: Fit inside training folds under the existing policy; no full-cohort or held-out fitted transform is produced here
concept_name_embedding_recipe: not yet selected; retain provider Word and WordContext for a later explicit naming rule
